mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances; tacrolimus increases risk of acute kidney injury while zoledronic acid directly impairs renal function, and both affect calcium/phosphate metabolism.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) and electrolytes (calcium, phosphate, magnesium) regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider dose adjustment or alternative bisphosphonate if renal function declines.
